tokens.description: Filled brand surface, hovered: brand shifted 7% away from text-inverse (lightened instead when the fill is too dark to darken visibly). Computed per theme.
Filled neutral surface, hovered: background-inverse shifted 7% away from text-inverse (or toward it when it can't move further). Computed per theme.
Brand at 7% opacity: see-through, so it tints toward brand on any surface. Brand outline/subtle hovers, menu and option highlights, Slider track.
Text color at 7% opacity: see-through, so it darkens light surfaces and lightens dark ones. Neutral outline/subtle hovers, neutral IconButton, table rows.
40% brand mixed into the background. Hovered tab indicator. Computed per theme.
Text-inverse at 7% opacity: see-through. Hover for neutral-inverse subtle icon buttons, which sit on background-inverse, brand, error, warning or success surfaces.
Filled error surface, hovered: error shifted 7% away from text-inverse. Computed per theme.
Filled warning surface, hovered: warning shifted 7% away from text-inverse. Computed per theme.
Filled success surface, hovered: success shifted 7% away from text-inverse. Computed per theme.
Error at 7% opacity: see-through. Danger outline/subtle hovers and danger menu items.
Warning at 7% opacity: see-through. Warning outline/subtle hovers.
Success at 7% opacity: see-through. Success outline/subtle hovers.
Milliseconds. Instant feedback, e.g. a button shrinking on press.
Milliseconds. Small state changes such as State Layer fades on hover.
Milliseconds. Settling back to rest, e.g. a button releasing after press.
CSS timing function: fast start, smooth stop. Use for all state transitions. In prototypes, set Smart Animate to Custom bezier 0.2, 0, 0, 1.
Scale applied to the visible layers of a pressed control (pointer and keyboard). The clickable area never shrinks. Not applied under reduced motion.
Code and CodeBlock background: black, the same in every theme, under the Monokai text colors.
